intervention_and_control.battle_continuation: Unchanged native Battle Search-v2@400, no potion/rule change.
intervention_and_control.control: One independently seeded pi_suffix legal action occurrence from the exact same replay-qualified root. pi_suffix = 0.80 ExpertNonCombatDriver + 0.20 uniform over all currently legal occurrences. Capture the action before stepping; do not use a C terminal outcome for efficacy claims.
intervention_and_control.native_game_rng: Fixed by owner seed and exact recorded legal-action prefix; never resampled between C and O candidate continuations.
intervention_and_control.oracle: Evaluate every legal action occurrence when candidate_count <= 14, with exactly 8 independently seeded stochastic pi_suffix terminal continuations per occurrence; each fixed attempt has a 20 process-CPU-second cap. Use the unchanged unique-highest-mean rule requiring its mean to exceed every other mean by >2x the unpaired Welch standard error. Any tie, insufficient/incomplete grid, timeout, or over-cap menu abstains to C.

registered_endpoints: all 32 selected-root denominators, eligibility, valid 2-SE winners and fallback reasons
actual O versus C legal occurrence switches
per-root, per-action and per-suffix process CPU, wall time, peak RSS, failures and cap exceedances
exhaustiveness of the registered eight continuations per candidate
96-owner O/C/E scenario CPU estimate using observed multichoice/menu frequencies; marginal p95 values must not be multiplied as a validated upper bound
descriptive uncertainty intervals only where meaningful; the selected debug roots do not support natural-population generalization

rng_streams.native_game_rng_stream: restored exact source checkpoint only; not resampled
